newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
ALBANIA, July 29 - Durres - Two vessels discharging of which 1 bagged flour, 1 bulk wheat. No vessels waiting in roads.

BULGARIA, July 29 - Varna - East - 2 Vessels loading at berth, 4 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge. West - 10 Vessels loading at berth, 3 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load. Bourgas - East - 17 vessels due, 5 loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth, 10 waiting at anchorage to load, 4 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 3 under repair/drydock, 1 awaiting orders. West - 2 Vessels loading at berth, 1 tanker in port. Bourgas - Eight vessels operating of which 5 loading, 1 metals, 1 fazer, 1 ammonia nitrate, 1 special cargo, 1 steel. 3 Discharging, 1 maize, 1 zinc concentrate, 1 crude oil. 9 Vessels waiting in roads of which 5 to load, 1 cars, 1 clinker, 1 metals, 1 benzene, 1 tanker. 2 To discharge, 1 iron concentrate, 1 sheet iron. 1 To load discharger copper anodes/zinc concentrates, 1 redelivery. 11 Vessels due of which 7 to load, 1 copper anodes, 4 steel, 1 pyrite concentrate, 1 metals. 4 To discharge, 3 iron ore, 1 coke.

Varna - 41 Vessels operating of which 26 loading, 5 urea, 3 cement, 10 soda, 1 cigarettes/containers, 2 quartz sand, 1 scrap, 1 general, 1 cigarettes, 1 kaoline, 1 clinker. 7 Discharging, 1 soya fodder/maize, 1 coke, 1 general, 2 coal, 1 cars, 1 phosphorite. 8 Discharging/loading, 2 trucks/containers, 6 container vessels. 10 Vessels waiting in roads of which 5 to load, 1 general, 2 urea, 1 cement, 1 clinker. 2 To discharge/load containers, 3 cargo not nominated.

CYPRUS, July 29 - Limassol - Vessels due on 30/7, 4 containers, 5 passenger vessels. No delays expected. 5 Container vessels discharging/loading at berth, 3 conventional vessels discharging at berth. Larnaca - Vessels due on 30/7, 1 container vessel, 1 conventional vessel. No delays expected. 1 container vessel discharging/loading at berth, 1 conventional vessel discharging at berth.

ESTONIA, July 29 - Tallinn - City port - 3 Vessels due, no delays expected. 1 Vessel loading steel billets at berth, 1 liner vessel, 1 awaiting orders. Kopli - 2 Vessels due, no delays expected. 2 Vessels loading at berth of which 1 sawn timber, 1 non-ferrous metals. 1 Vessel discharging frozen fish at berth. Parnu - 2 Vessels due, no delays expected. 2 Loading at berth of which 1 timber, 1 general cargo. 1 Vessel waiting at anchorage to load timber. Muuga - 6 Vessels due, no delays. 3 Loading at berth of which 1 peat moss, 2 oil products, 2 discharging at berth of which 1 frozen meat, 1 sugar, 1 clinker vessel.

ITALY, July 29 - Genoa commercial port - No vessels in roads, no delays. 24 Vessels berthed, 2 in drydock. Multedo oil harbour - One in roads, no delays, 1 vessel berthed. Savona - No vessels in roads, no delays, 3 vessels berthed. Vado Ligure - One vessel in roads, no delays, 2 vessels berthed. La Spezia - No vessels in roads, no delays, 9 vessels berthed, 5 under repair/drydock. Leghorn - Seven in roads, 36 berthed. Civitavecchia - One in roads. Gaeta, Salerno, Palermo, Ancona/Falconara - No vessels in roads, no delays. Naples - Four vessels in roads. August oil harbour - Four in roads, 3 berthed. Syracuse oil harbour - Two vessels in roads, 3 berthed. Sarroch - Four in roads, 5 berthed. Taranto - No vessels in roads, no delays, 14 vessels berthed. Ravenna - Six in roads. Venice - No delays. Trieste - Commercial port - No vessels in roads, no delays. Siot oil terminal - 1 Vessel in roads, 2 berthed, some delays.

LATVIA, July 29 - Riga - 19 Vessels operating of which 5 timber loaders, 2 containers, 2 tanker loaders, 2 steel, 1 fertiliser loader, 2 frozen foods dischargers, 2 waiting, 2 sugar dischargers, 2 other general cargo, no delays. 20 Vessels due. Ventspils - One vessel loading mop, 3 awaiting operations at outer anchorage, no delays.

LITHUANIA, July 28 - Klaipeda - Vessels loading in port, 8 fertiliser, 2 oil, 1 metal, 2 timber, 1 steel coils, 1 steel sheets, 1 scrap. Discharging, 3 fish, 1 general cargo, 1 fish powder, 1 corn, 1 soy pellets, 1 coke. 4 Vessels in roads, 29 due.

POLAND, July 29 - Gdynia - 11 Vessels operating of which 7 loading at berth (1 coal, 4 bulk, 2 general cargo). 3 Discharging at berth (2 general cargo, 1 bulk). 1 Waiting at anchorage to discharge, 9 under repair/drydock, 26 due. Gdansk - 11 Vessels operating of which 9 loading at berth (2 bulk, 1 timber, 3 general cargo, 2 coal). 2 Discharging at berth of which 1 general cargo, 1 tanker. 22 Vessels due. Szczecin - 58 Due. 31 Loading at berth, 27 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 to discharge, 12 under repair/drydock.

PORTUGAL, July 28 - Leixoes - Vessels operating 4 general cargo, 2 container vessels. No vessels waiting. Places vacant - 10 Piers with cranes, 2 piers without cranes. July 29 - Setubal - Vessels in port, 5 loading at berth, 6 discharging at berth, 5 awaiting berth, 5 under repair/drydock. Vessels due, 6 for discharging, 3 for loading, 1 for repair/drydock.

ROMANIA, July 28 - Constanta - 31 Vessels operating of which 20 generals loading, 7 bulkers (3 loading, 4 discharging), 2 bagged cement loading, 2 containers loading. 5 Vessels waiting in roads of which 1 general for loading, 2 bulkers for loading, 1 tanker for loading. Constanta Sud (Agigea) - Seven loading. Mangalia - No vessels. Midia - Five livestock carriers loading.

RUSSIA, July 28 - BALTIC PORTS - St. Petersburg - 24 Vessels operating of which loading, 3 non-ferrous, 4 general cargo, 8 fertiliser, 1 container vessel. Discharging, 1 frozen chicken, 1 rice, 1 container vessel, 3 fertiliser, 1 butter/cheese, 1 frozen fish. 14 Vessels awaiting operations, 11 due. Kaliningrad - 10 Vessels operating, no delays, 5 vessels due. Vyborg - Two vessels operating, no delays, 5 vessels due. Kaliningrad - Commercial port - 9 Vessels operating of which 6 loading (2 non-ferrous metals, 1 fertiliser, 1 coke, 1 gravel, 1 steel scrap). 3 Discharging, (1 trailers, 1 malt, 1 pellets), 9 due, no delays.

FAR EAST ports - Vladivostok - 11 Vessels in port of which 1 passenger. 4 Loading (1 timber, 1 steel scrap, 1 aluminium, 1 container vessel). 3 Discharging (2 cars, 1 sugar). 3 Waiting. Nakhodka - Seven vessels in port of which 2 loading (1 metal, 1 steel scrap), 5 waiting. Vostochniy - Seven vessels in port of which 4 loading (2 timber, 2 coal). 2 Containers discharging/loading, 1 waiting. Posyet, Zarubino - No vessels. No delays or congestion in ports.

BLACK SEA - Novorossiysk - 11 Vessels operating of which 8 loading 4 steel, 1 cast iron, 1 metals, 1 coal, 1 cellulose. 3 Discharging, 2 sugar, 1 oil. 14 Waiting in roads of which 5 to load, 1 urea, 1 iron cathodes, 3 steel. 9 To discharge, 4 sugar, 3 rice, 1 frozen poultry, 1 zinc concentrate. 41 Vessels due of which 30 to load, 17 steel, 1 tin, 3 aluminium, 1 copper, 3 copper cathodes, 1 cellulose, 1 cartoons, 2 urea, 1 coal. 7 To discharge, 2 sugar, 2 rice, 1 general, 1 citrus, 1 luggage. 4 To discharge/load containers. Oil terminal - July 29 - 1 Vessel berthed to load diesel, 4 tankers waiting in roads of which 3 crude, 1 fuel. 6 Tankers due to load, 4 crude, 1 diesel, 1 fuel.

NORTHERN BASIN, July 29 - Murmansk - Seven operating of which 1 apatite, 1 alumina, 1 steel, 1 coal, 1 non-ferrous metals, 1 aluminium, 1 cabotage. 1 Apatite loader waiting. 2 Due to load of which 1 apatite, 1 iron ore pellets.

UKRAINE, July 28 - Mariupol - Five vessels loading at berth (sulphur, metal products), 1 vessel discharging alumina at berth. 8 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load (metal products, sulphur, fertiliser). 3 Vessels reloading to sea-going vessels of which 2 urea, 1 fertiliser. 7 Floating storehouses (fertiliser, sulphur). 31 Vessels due for loading and discharging of metal products, sulphur, coal, ore, general cargo, urea, fertiliser, containers, clay, alumina. Kerch - Two vessels under repair/drydock, 2 due to load metal products, pig iron. Berdiansk - One vessel loading ore at berth, 2 due to load coke. Mariupol - Four vessels operating of which 3 loading, 1 sulphur, 2 billets, 1 discharging alumina. 10 Vessels waiting in roads of which 9 to load, 4 fertiliser, 5 steel, 1 to discharge urea. 32 Vessels due of which 24 to load, 13 steel, 4 fertiliser, 2 coal, 1 kaoline, 4 fire clay. 2 To discharge, 1 clay, 1 building materials, 1 to discharge/load containers/pipes/equipment, 5 to discharge/load containers.

Odessa - 14 Vessels operating of which 9 loading, 1 fertiliser, 5 metal, 1 sunflower seeds, 2 oil. 2 Discharging, 1 general, 1 bananas, 1 discharging/loading containers, 1 passenger. 1 Vessel waiting. 5 are Vessels waiting in roads of which 3 to load, 2 metal, 1 general, 1 to discharge general cargo, 1 awaiting owners notification. 17 Vessels due of which 14 to load, 8 metal, 2 paper, 1 equipment, 2 oil, urea. 1 To discharge sugar, 2 to discharge/load containers. Ilyichevsk - 12 Vessels operating of which 11 loading, 7 steel, 1 pig iron, 1 debars, 1 spirits, 1 potash, 1 discharging oil. 2 Vessels waiting in roads to load steel. 13 Vessels due of which 5 to load, 2 steel, 1 debars, 2 pig iron. 2 To discharge oil, 6 to discharge/load containers.

Odessa - Steel cargo loading, 7 vessels alongside, 1 anchored, 7 due. Containers - 2 Alongside, 1 due. Grain cargo discharge - 1 Vessel alongside. Tanker loading - 2 Vessels alongside, 2 due. General cargo - 2 Vessels alongside, 2 anchored, 2 due. Fertiliser - 1 Vessel due. Sugar - 1 Vessel due. Ilyichevsk - Steel cargo loading - 8 Vessels alongside. Containers - 1 Vessel alongside. 1 Tanker alongside for discharging, 1 fertiliser vessel alongside.

YUGOSLAVIA, July 29 - Bar - 12 Vessels berthed of which 4 discharging gasoline, 2 discharging bananas, 2 discharging flour, 1 loading rubber/metal, 2 loading steel coils, 1 loading other metals. Zelenika/Bijela - Three vessels berthed of which 1 discharging jet fuel, 1 discharging gasoline, 1 discharging diesel oil, 1 laid up, 3 under repair.
